'''Camp Talanis''' was a [[Voss commandos|commando]] outpost on the eastern edge of the [[Eastern Watchwoods]] in the [[Gormak Lands]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]]. The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] had a significant military presence there.
